'''2017 US Nationals Matt Carulli DS Combat Readiness (V)''' was the Dark Side constructed list played by [[Matt Carulli]] at [[2017 U.S. National Championship]] (Day 1).

== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' [[Combat Readiness (V)]]
* '''Format:''' [[Open]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 1
* '''Source:''' [https://www.starwarsccg.org/resources/tournament-decklists/ PC list]. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261013125443/https://swccg.com/snapshots/pc/tournament-decklists.html Internet Archive]
